title: General Consent to Treat
summary: Gives your care team permission to examine and treat you during this visit.
body: I agree to receive medical care and routine treatment from this practice's clinicians during this visit and any related follow-up care.

title: HIPAA Privacy Acknowledgment
summary: Confirms you received our Notice of Privacy Practices explaining how your health information is used.
body: I acknowledge that I have been offered a copy of this practice's Notice of Privacy Practices, which explains how my health information may be used and shared.

title: Financial Responsibility Agreement
summary: Confirms you understand you're responsible for costs your insurance doesn't cover.
body: I understand that I am responsible for any copay, deductible, or coinsurance amount not covered by my insurance plan, and agree to pay any outstanding balance after my insurer processes this visit.
